name: Layer
doc: Independently loaded and visible data layer, such as art, night or quest state.

fields.name: loaded
fields.doc: Load cells in this layer when a source is within range.

fields.name: visible
fields.doc: Presentation visibility; hiding preserves simulation residency.

fields.name: range
fields.doc: Distance outside a cell's bounds at which it becomes wanted.

fields.name: graceTicks
fields.doc: Fixed host ticks a cell remains resident after leaving the wanted set.
